fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6H3A65RDP761HKE82STZSQZ (log, roadmap and why page their output with a cursor, as ls already does). No owner was present. The planner read ls, feed and run log paging (internal/api/ls.go, feed.go, run_log.go), the why/log ops (internal/api/lineage.go), roadmap (internal/api/plan.go) and its in-repo callers (health's roadmap check, the roadmap TUI app, the model app's roadmap tab), then raised four choices to the arbiter: the roadmap page unit, how why pages its three lists, the shared limits and an --all escape hatch, and how whole-roadmap callers read once roadmap pages. The arbiter answered with Decision decision-paging-log-roadmap-why (assumed, would have escalated): limit 1-1000 default 100, opaque cursor, --all, next_cursor and a next: line; log pages change sets; roadmap pages change sets in group order, repeating a split group; why pages decisions, sources and change sets as one sequence after the full walk; health and the TUI apps ask for all. The change set serves the same intents as the backlog change set it replaces (01M5SWTHZSPBNQ), which is linked relates-to and withdrawn.
fields.title: Plan interview: paging log, roadmap and why
